source.title: Learning Objectives
source.narration: By the end of this chapter, you'll be equipped with essential foundational skills. You'll successfully install Python and configure your development environment, understanding the crucial roles of the Python interpreter and your Integrated Development Environment. You'll then write and execute your very first Python program using the fundamental print() function. We'll also explore Python's interactive mode, known as REPL, for quick experimentation. Finally, you'll learn to identify and troubleshoot common installation and basic syntax errors, empowering you to overcome initial hurdles with confidence.
